fields.headline: Geomagnetic Storm Category G4 or Greater Predicted

details.label: Supersedes
details.value: Any and all prior watches in effect

potentialImpacts.heading: Area of Impact
potentialImpacts.text: Primarily poleward of 45 degrees Geomagnetic Latitude.

potentialImpacts.heading: Induced Currents
potentialImpacts.text: Possible widespread voltage control problems; some protective systems may mistakenly trip key assets out of the grid.

potentialImpacts.heading: Spacecraft
potentialImpacts.text: Surface charging and tracking problems may occur; corrections may be needed for orientation problems.

potentialImpacts.heading: Navigation
potentialImpacts.text: Satellite navigation degraded for hours; low-frequency radio navigation disrupted.

potentialImpacts.heading: Radio
potentialImpacts.text: HF radio propagation sporadic or blacked out.

potentialImpacts.heading: Aurora
potentialImpacts.text: Aurora may be seen as low as 45 degrees geomagnetic latitude.

fields.footer: Exercise product. Not an official NOAA message.
